title: CovNovBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Time Series Foundation Models under Covariate Novelty
abstract: arXiv:2611.33732v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Covariate-aware time-series foundation models (TSFMs) condition their forecasts on additional input variables, called covariates, that are supplied over the future horizon. This capability makes them appealing for interventional forecasting, in which a target is predicted under a planned action such as a new product pricing policy or a new patient treatment schedule. We refer to covariates that encode such actions as treatment covariates. Current covariate-aware TSFMs, however, are trained on observed patterns, and their behavior is unclear when future treatment covariates fall outside the range seen in the history. Examples include a numerical treatment that leaves its historical range and a categorical treatment that takes a previously unseen policy. We call this practically common setting covariate novelty, and note that it is not systematically represented in existing benchmarks. We introduce an operational definition of covariate no

translated_title: CovNovBench：用于评估协变量新颖性情形下时间序列基础模型的基准测试
translated_abstract: 协变量感知的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）将其预测条件化于在未来时段内提供的额外输入变量，即协变量。这一能力使其在干预式预测中极具吸引力，即在计划行动下（例如新产品定价策略或新的患者治疗方案）预测目标变量。我们将编码此类行动的协变量称为处理协变量。然而，当前的协变量感知TSFM是在观测到的模式上训练的，当未来的处理协变量超出历史所见的范围时，其行为尚不明确。例如，数值型处理变量可能超出其历史取值范围，类别型处理变量可能采用先前从未见过的策略。我们将这种在实践中十分常见但未在现有基准测试中得到系统性体现的情形称为协变量新颖性，并为此给出了操作性定义。
tldr: 本文提出了CovNovBench基准，首次系统性地评估时间序列基础模型在协变量新颖性（即未来处理协变量超出历史观测范围，如新定价策略或新治疗方案）情形下的预测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CovNovBench, the first benchmark to systematically evaluate time series foundation models under covariate novelty, where future treatment covariates fall outside historically observed ranges such as unseen pricing policies or treatment schedules.
